nodes.label: Mobile App UI/UX Design Skill
nodes.rationale: A skill definition whose frontmatter description makes it auto-trigger on any request about mobile screens, mockups, onboarding, navigation, or React Native / Flutter / SwiftUI prototypes, so that agents apply a consistent design discipline instead of ad-hoc styling.

nodes.label: Core Design Philosophy (Intentionality Over Flashiness)
nodes.rationale: Great mobile UI is not about flashiness but intentionality: every pixel, spacing value and color must serve the user. Interfaces should feel smooth, personal and alive rather than merely functional. Three pre-design questions: what is the user trying to accomplish, how should this make them feel, and what is the one thing they should notice first.

nodes.label: 5-Step Mobile Design Process
nodes.rationale: Sequenced deliberately: context precedes structure, structure precedes visuals, and emotion/polish come last, so visual decisions are constrained by UX intent instead of decorating an unvalidated layout.

nodes.label: Typography Hierarchy Rules
nodes.rationale: One font family (two max), at most 4 sizes and 2 weights, monospace for metrics, text containers under 600px. Hierarchy is created with size, weight and opacity rather than bolding everything, because uniform weight destroys scannability.

nodes.label: 60/30/10 Color Rule
nodes.rationale: 60% neutral base, 30% complementary, 10% accent. Opacity variations of the neutral (100/80/60-70%) carry text hierarchy, accent at 5% opacity backs secondary buttons, and strong colors such as red are reserved for meaningful moments because overuse kills hierarchy. Shadow colors are tinted to match the background instead of pure gray/black.

nodes.label: 8-Point Grid Spacing System
nodes.rationale: All spacing divisible by 8 or 4 (8, 12, 16, 24, 32, 48, 64, 80, 96) plus relationship-based spacing: related elements close, unrelated far, and the gap to the next group is 2x the intra-group gap. Larger text needs larger spacing. Section padding 80-96px, card padding 24-32px.

nodes.label: Soft Tinted Shadow Rules
nodes.rationale: Soft shadows only, always tinted to the background hue; subtle white inner shadows on buttons add dimension. Harsh or pure-gray shadows read as cheap and break the color system.

nodes.label: Thumb Zone Placement
nodes.rationale: Primary actions belong in the bottom third of the screen so the core goal is reachable one-handed; placing CTAs outside it is listed as an anti-pattern.

nodes.label: F-Pattern Reading Order
nodes.rationale: Content is laid out along the natural F-shaped scan path so eyes hit the highest-value information without hunting.

nodes.label: Visual Cues and Imagery Guidance
nodes.rationale: Icons, emojis, illustrations and images make information digestible; for people, avatars/photos beat initials which beat generic icons. Consistent curated or AI-generated visuals with matching palettes, never a random stock-photo mix.

nodes.label: Step 4: Design for Emotion (Peak and End)
nodes.rationale: Only two moments are remembered: the peak and the end. Design the peak with micro-animations, celebratory feedback, sparkles and encouraging copy; design the ending with a summary card, progress affirmation and a gentle nudge to return. Motion doubles as a trust signal in high-stakes domains such as finance, crypto and health.

nodes.label: Step 5: Polish and Details
nodes.rationale: Glow behind key elements (blur + opacity), tiny white inner shadows on primary buttons, 5% primary-color borders, micro-animations, 44x44pt minimum tap targets, contrast checks, and all of error/empty/loading/success states designed. Polish is the difference between functional and alive.

nodes.label: Personalization by User Stage
nodes.rationale: New users get a simple welcome and guided setup, returning users get personalized routine-focused content with progress, power users get dense stats and optimization tools; adapting density to stage prevents both overwhelm and boredom.

nodes.label: Smarter Search Pattern
nodes.rationale: Never show a blank search screen; always surface recent searches, popular/trending items and personalized recommendations so the empty state still advances the user's goal.

nodes.label: Order/Status Tracking Pattern
nodes.rationale: Open with a confident status message, humanize with photos, names and quick actions, and use visual timelines instead of text date lists because timelines answer 'where is it now' at a glance.

nodes.label: Selection Over Manual Input
nodes.rationale: Tappable options for common choices reduce interaction cost and typing errors; icons/emojis add personality, and an 'Other' manual fallback preserves flexibility.

nodes.label: Mobile Design Anti-Patterns
nodes.rationale: Captured as a checklist so violations are recognizable: flashy gradients, >4 font sizes or >3 weights, off-grid spacing, key content hidden behind banners/taps, CTAs outside the thumb zone, guidance-free empty states, sliders for precise entry, flat visual weight, labels emphasized over values, and gray shadows on colored backgrounds.

nodes.label: Implementation Stack (React, Tailwind, Lucide, Recharts)
nodes.rationale: Chosen so the skill's static rules map onto utility classes and tokens: Tailwind for spacing/color/typography, CSS variables for the color system, Lucide for consistent iconography, Recharts for data viz, CSS transitions for micro-interactions, and a 375px (iPhone SE) mobile-first baseline with rounded-2xl/3xl and backdrop-blur.
